source_title: Olwethu Makhanya frustrated by 'leggy' Rangers - Scottish gossip - BBC
source_excerpt:
Late equaliser scorer Olwethu Makhanya feels Rangers showed "a lack of character" and "came out leggy" in the second half of Wednesday's 2-2 draw with Hearts at Tynecastle. ( Sun , external )
Right-back Chris Cadden, 30, may have added to Aberdeen's injury worries going into Saturday's League Cup semi-final with Rangers after limping off during Wednesday's 1-0 defeat by Falkirk . ( Sun , external )
